info.name: SawitHub API
info.description:
Complete API collection for SawitHub — Palm Oil Farm Management SaaS.

Routes use the backend's real RPC-style naming (e.g. `/api/CorePlotService`, `/api/IdentityAuthService/login`) — see `docs/api/openapi.yaml` and `apps/backend/docs/api-routes.md` for the authoritative route list.

## Setup

Set the following collection variables before use:

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `baseUrl` | `http://localhost:8000` | User backend base URL |
| `adminBaseUrl` | `http://localhost:8001` | Admin backend base URL |
| `token` | *(empty)* | User JWT — set automatically by Login |
| `adminToken` | *(empty)* | Admin JWT — set automatically by Admin Login |

## Auth Flow

1. Call **POST /api/IdentityAuthService/register** or **POST /api/IdentityAuthService/login**
2. Copy the `token` field from the response into the `token` collection variable
3. All protected endpoints automatically attach `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`

For admin endpoints, call **POST /api/admin/auth/login** and set `{{adminToken}}`.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Register, login, logout, and password reset flows.

request.description: Register a new user account. Returns JWT token and user object. Trial period (14 days) starts immediately.
Login with email and password. The test script automatically saves the returned token to `{{token}}`.
Revoke the current JWT by its JTI. Returns 204 No Content.
Invalidate all sessions by bumping the session_version in Redis. All existing JWTs for this user become invalid.
Check if the current token is still valid. Returns 204 on success, 401 if expired or revoked.
Send a 6-digit reset code to the user's email via Resend (Asynq queue: email:reset_code). Always returns 200 to prevent email enumeration.
Verify the 6-digit reset code sent by email before allowing a new password to be set.
Submit the 6-digit code to set a new password. Invalidates all existing sessions on success.

item.name: Profile
item.description: View and update the authenticated user's profile fields.

request.description: Returns full user profile including decrypted email, phone, and full_name (PII fields stored AES-256 encrypted).
Update full name. Minimum 3 characters if non-empty. PII encrypted at rest.
Update email address (stored lowercase). Must be a valid unique email. Updates email_enc and email_hash columns.
Update phone number. Pattern: ^[0-9+\-\s]{8,15}$. Stored encrypted.
Update username. Minimum 3 characters. Must be unique.
Change password. Requires current password for verification. Invalidates all sessions on success.

item.name: Lahan (Farms)
item.description: CRUD and active-farm management. Trial accounts limited to 2 active farms.

request.description: Returns array of all farms belonging to the authenticated user.
Create a new farm. `nama_kebun` is required. `luas_ha` must be > 0. `tahun_tanam` must be between 1900 and 2100. Requires RequireFullAccess (Pro or active trial) — returns 402 if exceeded.
Soft or hard delete a farm. Returns 404 if not found or not owned by user.

item.name: Panen (Harvest)
item.description: Record and manage palm oil harvest events. Trial limited to 2 total harvest records.

request.description: Returns array of all harvest records for the authenticated user.

Record a new harvest. `tanggal_panen` must not be in the future. Computed columns `berat_ton`, `total_pendapatan`, and `hasil_bersih` are generated by the DB. Trial accounts limited to 2 harvests — returns 402 when exceeded.

item.name: Perawatan (Maintenance)
item.description: Record farm maintenance activities: fertilizing, spraying, pruning, etc.

request.description: `id_lahan`, `tanggal_perawatan`, and `jenis_perawatan` are required. `jumlah` must be > 0. `harga_satuan` and `biaya_pekerja` must be >= 0. Requires RequireFullAccess.

item.name: Jadwal Perawatan (Schedule)
item.description: Recurring maintenance schedule templates with flexible frequency options.

request.description: `frequensi_tipe` enum: `daily`, `weekly`, `monthly`, `custom`. If `custom`, `frequensi_custom_hari` must be a positive integer. `tanggal_akhir` must be >= `tanggal_mulai` if provided.
List upcoming maintenance schedules across all farms.

item.name: Pendapatan (Income)
item.description: Record TBS (Fresh Fruit Bunch) sales/income transactions.

request.description: `total_janjang` must be a positive integer. `total_berat_kg` must be > 0. `pendapatan_kotor` and `biaya_total` must be >= 0. `pendapatan_bersih` is a DB-generated column (pendapatan_kotor - biaya_total).

item.name: Harga TBS (TBS Price)
item.description: Manage TBS (Tandan Buah Segar) price reference data per period.

request.description: This backend only exposes a read-only list — there is no create/update/delete route for commodity prices.

item.name: Field Checklist
item.description: Task-based field inspection runs. Create a run, complete tasks within it, then mark complete.

request.description: `id_lahan`, `title`, and `task_date` are required. `tasks` is an optional array of task items.
Mark the run as complete and update task completion statuses.

item.name: Dashboard
item.description: Aggregated farm performance metrics. Cached in Redis for 30 seconds.

query.description: Aggregation period. Options: weekly, monthly, yearly

request.description: Returns aggregated metrics: total_berat_ton, total_pendapatan, total_biaya, net_income, chart_data, biaya_breakdown, upcoming_perawatan, recent activity. Cached per user+period+lahan in Redis for 90s.

item.name: Laporan (Reports)
item.description: Financial reports and PDF export. Reports cached for 2 minutes.

request.description: Returns financial report summary and per-category detail for the requested period. Requires Pro subscription — returns 402 for trial accounts.
Trigger async PDF generation via Asynq (email:report queue). Returns 202 Accepted with a job ID or download URL. Requires Pro subscription.
Returns `{"items": [...]}` wrapper. Returns 503 if Redis notification service is unavailable.
Mark all unread notifications as read. Returns 200 with updated count.
Mark a single notification as read by ID. Returns 200 with the updated notification.
Permanently delete all notifications the user has already read. Returns 200 with the deleted count.

item.name: Subscription & Billing
item.description: Subscription status, Midtrans checkout, and payment history.

request.description: Returns SubscriptionView: subscription_status, access_mode (trial/pro/expired), days_remaining, trial_remaining, plan_name, plan_price (Rp 30,000), can_checkout, active_farm_limit.
Create a Midtrans Snap checkout session. Returns `snap_token` and `redirect_url` for the payment page. IDR currency, Rp 30,000/month.

item.name: Admin — Auth
item.description: Admin authentication. Uses separate JWT secret (ADMIN_JWT_SECRET) and database (sawit_hub_admin_db).

request.description: Authenticate as an admin user. Token is signed with ADMIN_JWT_SECRET. The test script automatically saves the token to `{{adminToken}}`.
Returns the authenticated admin's profile from sawit_hub_admin_db.
Revoke the current admin JWT by its JTI. Returns 204 No Content.
Revoke all active JWTs for this admin account (bumps session_version). Returns 204 No Content.

item.name: Admin — Users
item.description: Admin user management: list, view, update status, delete.

request.description: Returns paginated user list from sawit_hub_db. Response: `{"users": [...], "total": n, "page": 1, "limit": 20}`.
Update user account status. Valid values: `active`, `suspended`, `trial`. Suspending a user invalidates their sessions via Redis session_version bump.
Change a user's role (e.g. promote to admin). Requires super_admin. Returns 200 with the updated user.
Disable a user account (sets is_active=false) without deleting it. Returns 200 with the updated user.
Force-set a user's password as an admin action. Returns 204 No Content.

item.name: Admin — Data & Analytics
item.description: Platform-level analytics. Overview cached 3 minutes, trends cached 5 minutes.

request.description: Returns platform-wide metrics: total_users, active_users, pro_subscribers, trial_users, total_revenue, visit_trends. Cached for 3 minutes.
Includes user growth, harvest trends, and platform-wide usage metrics in one payload.
Returns raw platform data tables for the admin data-browser view.

item.name: Admin — System & Settings
item.description: API kill-switch controls and audit logs. APIGate middleware reads endpoint state from Redis.

request.description: Returns the enabled/disabled state for all registered API endpoints. State is stored in Redis.
Enable or disable a specific API endpoint. Disabled endpoints return 503. Changes take effect within the Redis propagation window. This is the admin kill-switch (APIGate middleware).
Returns paginated admin action audit log. Records all write operations performed by admin users.
Global kill-switch: disable/enable the entire user-facing API at once. Distinct from the per-endpoint toggle above.
Get current platform settings (e.g. theme config, feature flags visible to admins).
Update platform settings. Returns 200 with the updated settings.

item.name: _Environments
item.description: Reference folder — not requests. Contains environment variable values for quick reference.

request.description:
# Environment Variable Reference

This is a reference request — not meant to be sent. Use the table below to configure collection variables.

## Development

| Variable | Value |
|---|---|
| `baseUrl` | `http://localhost:8000` |
| `adminBaseUrl` | `http://localhost:8001` |
| `token` | *(set via Login response)* |
| `adminToken` | *(set via Admin Login response)* |

## Staging (Railway)

| Variable | Value |
|---|---|
| `baseUrl` | `https://sawithub-backend-staging.up.railway.app` |
| `adminBaseUrl` | `https://sawithub-admin-backend-staging.up.railway.app` |

## Production (Railway)

| Variable | Value |
|---|---|
| `baseUrl` | `https://sawithub-backend.up.railway.app` |
| `adminBaseUrl` | `https://sawithub-admin-backend.up.railway.app` |

## Rate Limiting

All authenticated endpoints are rate-limited via a Redis-backed token bucket: 100-token burst capacity per user, refilling at 2 tokens/sec (~120 requests/minute sustained). Exceeding returns HTTP 429.

## Subscription Guards

Endpoints marked with ⚠️ 402 require Pro subscription or active trial:
- `POST /api/CorePlotService` — farm creation blocked after trial limit (1 farm)
- `POST /api/CoreHarvestService` — harvest creation blocked after trial limit (2 harvests)
- `POST /api/CoreMaintenanceService` — requires RequireFullAccess
- `GET /api/ReportingFarmFinanceService` — Pro only
- `POST /api/ReportingExportService/email-export` — Pro only
